definitions.explanation: To no longer have something that one previously had.

examples.japanese: {事故|じこ}で{命|いのち}を{失|うしな}った。
examples.english: Lost their life in an accident.

notes:
{失|うしな}う means to lose something (abstract or concrete).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {自信|じしん}を{失|うしな}う: to lose confidence
- {意識|いしき}を{失|うしな}う: to lose consciousness
- {命|いのち}を{失|うしな}う: to lose one's life

DON'T CONFUSE:
- {失|うしな}う: to lose (abstract, permanent)
- なくす: to lose (concrete objects)
